worked: Static HTML for all 12 public routes reduced mobile LCP from 2555–2858ms on the Next-rendered fallback to 1357–1359ms on the default candidate.
Route-scoped metadata, schema, answer-first FAQs and llms.txt pass local validators and live local SEO audit with zero findings.
Source-pinned project evidence keeps 10 supported metrics visible and filters the one pending-source metric.
The résumé PDF hash matches the exact owner-supplied file.
The default candidate passes Chromium and WebKit at 390px and 1440px, with 48 Windows and 48 Linux visual baselines.
BusinessOS connector health and snapshot are verified read-only against the feature branch with five portfolio-scoped editable paths.

Protected Vercel preview target is Ready; all 12 public routes pass live browser metadata/schema checks, the bypass-authenticated SEO audit has 0 findings, and live contact-origin rejection/PDF checks pass.
failed: The Next-rendered fallback exceeded the strict mobile LCP gate on all 12 routes; D30 made the passing Astro static hybrid the default and retained Next as a rollback path.
The configured provisional canonical URL returns 404. A protected noindex preview is deployed, but no public production URL, indexing, rankings or AI citations are claimed.
Vercel auto-assigned the project's first CLI deployment to production; the accidental deployment and its aliases were removed. The current deployment target is preview.
BusinessOS default-branch health still lacks the root gateway manifest because the feature branch has not been integrated into main; no PR or publish was created.
